## About
The Bumper Doctor is a bumper shop on Billmark Avenue in Austell. We take original, direct-from-the-manufacturer bumpers and recondition them to like-new condition.
A remanufactured bumper fits your car as well as a brand-new OEM bumper, costs less, and keeps one more plastic bumper out of the landfill. We sell to drivers and set up accounts for body shops.
Customers rate us 4.4 from 101 Google reviews, and regulars mention Brian and his team by name.

## Services
- Remanufactured OEM bumpers: Reconditioned bumpers that save you money and fit your car as well as a brand-new OEM bumper.
- Bumper repair: Our technicians repair damaged bumpers so you can keep the original part on your car.
- Delivery for business accounts: Body shops and other business accounts can have bumpers delivered.

## FAQ
Q: I run a body shop. How do I set up an account?
A: Contact us with your tax ID and we will get you pricing and set up your account.

Q: Can you ship a bumper to me?
A: Yes. We can arrange bumper shipping anywhere in the continental U.S.

Q: How soon will I hear back about a bumper?
A: Send us your make, model and years covered, plus the OEM or Partslink number if you have it. We reply within 1 business day, Monday through Friday.
